content: अवयविन् {%a.%} [अवयवः कारणत्वेनास्त्यस्य इनि] Having limbs, having portions or subdivisions (as a whole); अवयविना सह पूर्वादयः समस्यन्ते <ls>P. II. 2. 1. Sk.</ls> {%m.%} ({@-वी@}) .²1 A whole, any substance formed of several constituents; ननु अवयविनि किं मानम् <ls>Sid. Mukt.</ls> .²2 A syllogism, or any logical argument.
